description: This file contains utility functions for validating and obtaining control values compatible with a datasource in the Superset frontend, including handling of metrics, columns, and filters.

methods.name: isControlValueCompatibleWithDatasource
methods.description: Checks if a given control value is compatible with the datasource based on its type (metric, column, filter, or SQL metric).

methods.name: getControlValuesCompatibleWithDatasource
methods.description: Filters or validates control values to ensure they are compatible with the datasource, returning defaults if not.
